meaning_zh: vi.跌跌撞撞地走，蹒跚,结巴,弄错，失足,偶然碰见
example_en: The way of the wicked is as darkness : they know not at what they stumble.
example_zh: 19恶人的道好像幽暗.自己不知因什吗跌倒.
